'''The Foothill Caverns''' is a cave found in [[Darrow Hill]] in [[Hillsbrad Foothills]]. It is here that the [[Flame of Azel]] and [[Flame of Veraz]] were located.<ref>[[Helcular's Revenge (2)]]</ref> The caverns are also home to [[Alterac Granite]].

[[Helcular]] used the cave as his lair to conduct his transformation into a [[lich]] when a [[human]] lynch mob discovered his ritual lair in the hills and brutally killed him. Afterward, [[yeti]]s overtook the lair.<ref>[[Helcular's Revenge]]</ref>
